chunks: (Fear) Allāh and keep Allāh in view
because it is the pillar of your religion.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of prayer as the pillar of religion in Imam Ali's last will?
ai.summary: In his final testament to Hasan and Husayn, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elevates Salah as the structural pillar (amud) of faith, a metaphor reflecting its role in sustaining the entire edifice of religious practice. This emphasis aligns with the Shia scholarly tradition that views prayer not merely as ritual but as the primary means of maintaining spiritual connection and divine presence (hudur). The instruction underscores the continuity of prophetic guidance, linking the domestic sphere of the Ahl al-Bayt directly to the core obligations of the Ummah.
